'''David Rice Hedgley Jr.''' (born January 21, 1937 in Chicago, Illinois and died April 13, 2024 in Seal Beach, California) was an American [[computer scientist]] and [[mathematician]] who  made major contributions to the field of [[computer graphics]]. One of his contributions was the solution of the hidden-line problem in computer 3D graphics.<ref name="hiddenline">{{cite journal | last= Hedgley | first= David Rice (Jr.) | year= 1982 | title= A general solution to the hidden-line problem | journal= National Aeronautics and Space Administration | url= http://www.nasa.gov/centers/dryden/pdf/87948main_H-1162.pdf | archive-date= February 5, 2005 | access-date= March 25, 2015 | archive-url= https://web.archive.org/web/20050205051754/http://www.nasa.gov/centers/dryden/pdf/87948main_H-1162.pdf | url-status= dead }}</ref>
